lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least four distinguishable vertical columns, with 3 to 5 nodes per column, situated between the primary mid-lateral ridge and the pectoral insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, with high-luminance blobs centered at the intersections of these bands and the horizontal carinae axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extends horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance on the dorsal aspect to low-luminance shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary pectoral fin in the foreground displays a high-density distribution of small, high-contrast white spots across its visible surface area.
